verdict.rationale: The Canada Revenue Agency is a national tax authority whose registration, filing and account services are sovereign, centrally operated government functions, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of entity. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution, and EFILE-certified software is third-party tooling that transmits to the CRA rather than a hosted instance of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
